label: Ikony · Charleston
desc: Špičky ven a dovnitř, kopy dozadu, kroky vpřed a vzad, mávání rukama nahoře.
desc_en: Toes swinging out and in, kicks behind, quick steps forward and back, hands waving overhead.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer stands with knees together and pivots both feet so the toes swing outward and then inward in quick rhythm, and ends with feet parallel
the dancer kicks one foot backward and then the other, alternating, while the hands cross and uncross over the knees, and ends with both feet down
the dancer takes quick small steps forward and back with knees bent and toes turned out, arms swinging, and ends with feet together
both arms wave high in the air with open palms while the knees bounce, and end raised
the dancer strikes a pose with one leg stretched straight back, toe pointed, arms out to the sides, and holds it
